## 2. 开发信模板（英文，按客户类型）

### A. 品牌商/方案商（OEM/ODM）——最优先，主打深度定制

**Subject: Second source for managed switches — deep OEM/ODM, stable chip supply**

> Hi [Name],
>
> I'm Simon from Saga Telecom (Shenzhen). We supply managed/PoE switches — Marvell-based access, industrial lines, and L3/10G aggregation — with deep OEM/ODM support.
>
> I've followed [Company]'s work with Edgecore/open networking — impressive. Many teams like yours keep Edgecore for flagship projects but need a **second source** for:
> - Deep customization: Web GUI, CLI, MIB, default config, firmware branding (not just logo stickers)
> - Stable chip inventory & short lead time
> - Flexible MOQ and project pricing
>
> Would a short call next week make sense? Happy to sign an NDA first and share our feature list & customization matrix.
>
> Best regards,
> Simon | Saga Telecom | https://sagatele.com

### B. 分销商/电商（现货标品）

**Subject: Managed & PoE switches — in-stock supply, private label ready**

> Hi [Name],
>
> We're a Shenzhen-based switch supplier (Marvell-based L2+/PoE, CCTV & industrial models, 8–48 ports). Chips in stock, fast delivery, CE/RoHS/FCC/REACH/UKCA certified.
>
> Looking at your portfolio, our models can fill the **price-performance gap** and we support OEM/ODM private labeling. May I send our catalog and a sample quotation for your top-selling models?
>
> Best regards,
> Simon

### C. 集成商/项目商（CCTV/园区/工业）

**Subject: Project pricing for PoE/CCTV switches — ERPS, PoE++, IGMP ready**

> Hi [Name],
>
> We supply project-ready managed PoE switches (ERPS ring, PoE++, IGMP snooping, VLAN/QoS/ACL) for CCTV, campus and industrial deployments. As a supply-chain-first partner, we can **optimize BOM and pricing per project** and support customization of management UI/CLI.
>
> If you have an upcoming project, I'd be glad to build a tailored BoM and quotation — even for a pilot.
>
> Best regards,
> Simon

## 3. 跟进节奏（长期主义，按我方策略）

| 阶段 | 节奏 | 动作 |
|---|---|---|
| 第 0-2 周 | D+2, D+7 | 首封 → 简短跟进（附 catalog/feature list）|
| 第 1-3 月 | 每 3-4 周 | 价值型跟进：新品、案例、芯片行情、认证进展 |
| 第 3-12 月 | 每 6-8 周 | 节日/展会（GITEX、Computex、OCP）+ 项目线索询问 |
| 1 年以上 | 每季度 | 保持在客户池；官网升级、新认证、新案例同步更新 |

> **心法（用户原话存档）**：1 次跟进不行就 10 次，10 次不行就 2 年 5 年。随着我越来越专业、网站搞起来，优质客户就容易成交了。

## 4. 回复要点速查（常见客户问题）

| 客户问 | 打法 |
|---|---|
| "We use Edgecore / MikroTik" | 命中目标！定位第二货源：同等功能 + 深度定制 + 交期库存；不贬低对方品牌 |
| "Price too high" | 问配置/年用量再让利；项目型可优化方案降 BOM；拒绝纯价格战 |
| "Can you OEM?" | **主场**：UI/CLI/MIB/固件/标签/包装/说明书/Boot Logo 全链路；给定制矩阵 |
| "Certifications?" | 亮 CE/RoHS/FCC/REACH/UKCA；坦诚无 UL/KC/轨交/E-mark，避免接此类项目 |
| "Cloud management?" | 不做云管，坦诚划界；推本地管理（CLI/Web/SNMP）场景 |
| 公司规模/信任 | 强调供应商研发实力（Smartbyte/Hohunet）、芯片库存、行业深耕；弱化"贸易商"、突出"工程+供应链" |
